latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Subtitle Generator CapCut (v1.0.0)
- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM video files up to 500MB for rapid auto-generated English subtitles
- Subtitles are auto-synced to the speech, with captioned video files returned in 30–60 seconds
- Quick cloud-based workflow: upload, describe your need, receive ready-to-download videos at 1080p
- No manual editing or software setup required; ideal for TikTok and Reels creators needing fast captions
